shared_elements: possible anthropomorphic facial features (paired rounded forms suggesting eyes/brows)
object mounted on a museum plinth/support
justification: Both are pitted, eroded stone carvings shown on museum mounts, and each presents paired rounded relief swellings that could be read as facial features, which is the most specific correspondence available. Against that, A is a complete standing monolith with crisply incised geometric motifs (disc, bands, headdress) arranged in a legible vertical scheme, while B is a tight close-up of a fragmentary, softly modelled mass with no incised detail and no comparable overall composition.
